Hello again! I’d like to request another couple!
https://www.deviantart.com/stash/21ake0li2ic4
 
- A tired older man who is a clockmaker and inventor. He is stoic and serious, but he is nice to his maid. He has a monocle with a clock on it and has clockwork motifs in his outfit.
- A maid who is an assistant the clockmaker. She is actually the spirit of a cuckoo clock that came to life! She is soft-spoken, cheerful, very curious, and very clumsy. She loves following the clockmaker around!
- Their story is that one day the clockmaker makes a cuckoo clock and mysteriously disappears. The cuckoo clock turns into a young woman and goes out searching for him! They eventually reunite and live in an old clock tower.
- Their motifs are owls, clocks, nature, books, gears/tools, ballroom dancing.

Please draw any scene you’d like! For some ideas, you can draw them inside or outside a clock tower or in the man’s workshop.

Please appeal if the amount is not enough. Thank you for reading!

Nice to meet you, excuse my request.

Could you please illustrate two original characters?

Main Idea: I would like to see the two characters exploring each other, knowing that they are both bounty hunters, and playing tense games with each other, while still maintaining an atmosphere of ambiguous affection.
Sub (if it fits your request): A situation in which they spend time together like a normal couple, but with a slightly sweet atmosphere is also acceptable.

Costume

You may choose any of the outfits in the URLs below.
You are also welcome to design your own.

Composition and poses

There are no detailed specifications, so we leave it up to your sense of style.

About the data to be delivered

We would appreciate it if you could provide us with the following formats.
Transparent PNG or PSD file (characters only)
PSD file with a PSD layer that can be switched between the address "Yao" and the signature.

Applications
SNS icons and headers
Printing for personal use

If the reference image is unclear, or if there is no explanation as to which image should be used as a reference, you are free to draw freely.
If it is deemed inappropriate, you are free to cancel this request.
　　We apologize for any rudeness. Thank you for your cooperation. ＞＜Thank you very much for your cooperation.

He never gets genuinely mad at Luka's pranks and goes with the flow. Kasper loves dragging Luka around when he can. He is taller than Luka.

Hello, I'm a newcomer to this site! I am sending you a request to draw the two protagonists of a TRPG scenario of your own creation, if possible.

Here are the details.
▼ Lila Sullivan.
Special Agent at Scotland Yard. She is a blonde woman with a penchant for wearing men's clothes and is cheerful and good-natured.
In reality, she is a serial killer, and although this time she is on Frederick's side until the end, she is a disquieting element who could be the mastermind or the last boss at any moment. She is Watson, Moriarty, and Irene Adler.

Height-171cm
Age-24
Strengths-Lying, acting, quick hands, drug development

▼ Frederick MacPhail.
Psychiatrist and Scotland Yard's only consulting detective. A dusky blond-haired man with a pipe. Expressionless and rather taciturn, always calm, a cold monster who thinks he is a sensible man.
One day, he begins to suffer from hallucinations in which he sees people's faces as monsters, but by pursuing the mystery of a case brought to him by Lila, he is able to get closer to the true nature of his hallucinations.

Height-186cm
Age-34 years old
Areas of expertise - reasoning, persuasion, counseling

▼ About Requests

Worldview-London in the late 19th century. The system is set in the Cthulhu Mythos TRPG, and the mastermind may also be a monster or an inhuman creature. There is mystery, detective, and English romance.

Hope - I would be happy to draw as you wish without being bound by the material! It's also fine to ignore all excerpts from the book and other material in the drawings and materials. I will leave it to you to handle.
I love your comfortable compositions, exciting colors, and stylish compositions, so I would be very happy if you could freely draw the requested materials and character details as if they were an accessory.
